description: Phase 20 quality-baseline suite. Deliberately smaller than v1 (60 cases): a human listening pass has to be finishable in a few sittings, and 60 cases is how a baseline ends up half-scored. Every case here earns its place by testing something a human listener reported as wrong. Fixed and version-controlled — prompts are never edited to chase a better score. Any change requires a new benchmark_version, and only identical versions are compared.
lyrics_policy: All lyrics are original text written for this benchmark. No commercial or copyrighted lyrics appear anywhere in this file. No artist names are used in any prompt.
raw_only: Scores describe the RAW model master. The Phase 14 finished master is evaluated separately and must never stand in for model quality.

sets.GEN: General coverage across genre, language and vocal presentation.
sets.TROT: Anti-trot probes. Each prompt explicitly asks for restrained contemporary delivery. If the trot-like phrasing survives an explicit instruction not to do it, the bias is in the model rather than the prompt — which decides whether this is a prompting problem or a training problem.
sets.KO: Korean lyric stress set. Evaluation-only, never trainable. Expected lyrics are preserved verbatim so omission, reordering and phonetic corruption can be scored, and so ASR alignment can be added later without regenerating.
